title: Backport request: hyperV powershell path escape (CVE-2026-33414) on v5.7
body:
## Backport request: hyperV powershell path escape fix (CVE-2026-33414)

The upstream fix [`571c842b`](https://github.com/containers/podman/commit/571c842bd3) — *"hyperV: fix powershell path escape"* (PR [#24289](https://github.com/containers/podman/pull/24289), associated with CVE-2026-33414) appears to land on `main` only and is not yet on the `v5.7` stable branch.

### Evidence

- Comparison `v5.7...571c842bd3` reports `status=diverged, ahead=915, behind=92`.
- Title-based scan of the last 100 commits on `v5.7` does not find a cherry-pick of this commit (no message matching "powershell path escape" or `CVE-2026-33414`).
- The affected file `pkg/machine/hyperv/stubber.go` is still present on `v5.7` and still uses the pre-fix pattern of interpolating `imagePath.GetPath()` directly into the PowerShell command line (rather than passing it via the `IMAGE_PATH` environment variable as the fix does).

### Suggested action

Cherry-pick `571c842bd3` to `v5.7` (and presumably the still-supported `v5.6` / `v5.5` branches if they remain in the stable rotation). The patch is small (+2 / -1 in a single function `resizeDisk`).

### Diff sketch

```go
- resize := exec.Command("powershell", []string{"-command", fmt.Sprintf("Resize-VHD \"%s\" %d", imagePath.GetPath(), newSize.ToBytes())}...)
+ resize := exec.Command("powershell", "-command", fmt.Sprintf("Resize-VHD \"$ENV:IMAGE_PATH\" %d", newSize.ToBytes()))
  ...
+ resize.Env = append(os.Environ(), "IMAGE_PATH="+imagePath.GetPath())
```

This sidesteps PowerShell argument interpretation of special characters in the image path.

*Filed as part of an effort to flag missing security backports across stable branches. Not a maintainer; please correct me if I have misread the branch state.*

*Suggested label: backport*

comments.body: We only support the latest version
Closing as not_planned per the lifecycle guidance. Appreciate the time triaging.
